subject: Invasion of Privacy
text: The achievement was bugfixed and requires seeing Mallow's textbox shouting at the player for spying on him.

evidence.quote: You need to see Mallow's textbox shouting at you for spying on him.

subject: Invasion of Privacy
text: One player unlocked it by triggering the cutscene while standing to the top left of the star.

evidence.quote: triggering the cutscene while standing to the top left of the star

subject: Invasion of Privacy
text: Before the fix the achievement sometimes needed several save reloads to trigger.

evidence.quote: Took a few reloading my save till it took

subject: First-Class Pirate
text: All the clues must be collected in a single visit.

evidence.quote: You need to get them all in a single visit.

subject: First-Class Pirate
text: The achievement did not pop when the squid battle happened between the clues; the player had to redo them all.

evidence.quote: pop at first when I did them with the squid battle in between. Had to do them all again

subject: First-Class Pirate
text: Some players reported it popping after getting 5 of the 6 hints.

evidence.quote: This popped for me when I got 5 of the 6 hints.

subject: Sunken Treasure
text: The secret Frog Coin is right after the Doppleganger Mario area, in the next room with three Dry Bones, one of which walks behind a wall of J blocks; go behind the blocks and hug the wall.

evidence.quote: right after the 'Doppleganger Mario' area, in the next room with three Dry Bones walked around, one of which walks behind a wall of "J" blocks. Go behind the blocks and hug the wall.

subject: Sunken Treasure
text: A hidden door in the wall of J blocks in basement 4 leads to the treasure.

evidence.quote: basement 4 in wall of J have an hidden door to catch that treasure

subject: Sunken Secret
text: The hidden room is found after fighting Calamari, behind the barrels in the big water room with the Bloober and its baby Bloobers.

evidence.quote: The room  can be found after fighting Calamari. Check behind the barrels in the big water room with the Bloober that has the little baby Bloobers behind them.

subject: Unfair Fighting
text: Johnny starts with 3 adds; do not kill all of them and he will not duel Mario one-on-one.

evidence.quote: he starts with 3 adds, just don't kill all 3 of them and he won't duel you

subject: Unfair Fighting
text: Killing all but one of Johnny's underlings makes the fight easier, and as long as one is alive the fight will not become a 1v1.

evidence.quote: I'd recommend killing all but one of his underlings so they aren't as much of a pain. As long as even one is alive, the fight won't turn into a 1v1.

subject: Unfair Fighting
text: Johnny's 1v1 phase happens if all his underlings are killed, ruining the achievement.

evidence.quote: Se todos os capangas o boss vai eliminar propor uma luta 1x1 e lá se vai o troféu.
evidence.translation: If all the henchmen are eliminated the boss will propose a 1v1 fight and there goes the trophy.

subject: Unfair Fighting
text: Leave only one of the 4 henchmen alive and ignore it until the end, focusing on the boss.

evidence.quote: Dos 4 capangas deixe apenas 1 na batalha e depois o ignore até o final mudando o foco para o boss.
evidence.translation: Of the 4 henchmen leave only 1 in the battle and then ignore it until the end, switching focus to the boss.

subject: Unfair Fighting
text: Before the logic fix, beating Johnny without 1v1ing by not beating his underlings did not trigger the achievement at first; the pause lock was made more precise.

evidence.quote: I just beat him without 1v1ing him by not beating his underlings, and it didn't trigger
I've made the pause lock a little more precise

subject: Walk the Plank
text: The Johnny boss achievement and the Unfair Fighting achievement can be earned together in the same fight.

evidence.quote: Da pra ganhar os dois juntos.
